The one exception is the lane's artefact hashes, which I recomputed from the scratchpad files and which match. Two things deviate from the requested procedure. (1) I ran the gate with --only-suites, because the gate's own make api-test starts infrx-d1-postgres on 55432, which this brief forbids, and INFRX_D_TASK=e3b2 collides with E2's postgres on 56732 while the stack is up. The 3 W reds in api-test are caused by my private deep TMPDIR (they pass with the default TMPDIR) and are not an E3B finding. Not re-derived: the lane's D drill copy on both images, and the scratch merge at 7ed6993 (I merged into the newer 88feb1f and the newer I3B head 95b7df7).
